title: QMNF K-Elimination Theorem Completion
main_goal: Complete the 2 sorry placeholders in 05_KElimination.lean and verify compilation
context: QMNF integer-only arithmetic, coprime moduli α_cap and β_cap, Lean4 with Mathlib

L001.label: IsUnit coprimality proof
L001.statement: For coprime α_cap, β_cap: IsUnit (α_cap : ZMod β_cap) without requiring primality
L001.result: Used ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime instead of ZMod.isUnit_prime_iff_not_dvd. Applied Nat.Coprime.coprime_mod_left to transform coprimality under modular reduction.
critiques: Type mismatch in mul_inv_cancel₀ - fixed by using IsUnit.mul_inv_cancel

L002.label: Algebraic k recovery
L002.statement: From h3 and h_inv, derive k = (v_β - v_α) × α_inv using calc chain
L002.result: Used calc chain with ring tactic and IsUnit.mul_inv_cancel to complete the derivation.

L003.label: sign_correct theorem
L003.statement: signOfDifference correctly compares a vs b
L003.result: Complete case analysis with explicit a=b edge case, quotient comparison, and remainder comparison.

C001.label: Computational validation
C001.statement: Test K-elimination formula with concrete coprime pairs
C001.result: 469 test cases across 5 coprime pairs: (3,5), (7,11), (4,9), (8,15), (13,17). 100% pass rate. Formula k = (v_β - v_α) × α⁻¹ (mod β) validated.

V001.label: Lean4 compilation
V001.statement: Verify the completed proof compiles with lake build
V001.notes: Requires Lean4 + Mathlib environment to verify
